frame: hull-local hat units afloat: x across (owner braid +X), z along (bow -Z), y from the brim top (negative down) with the crown at the bowl squash; scale positions' y by squash/bowl_squash on another squash, never the items
item_rule: draw the first min(count, max_count) items of the tier for the total stored portions; stored kinds ranked by count (ties: first stored) map to clusters 0..3; an item whose cluster kind has no portion left takes the kind with the most left; the item model is drawn centred on pos, rotated by quaternion [x, y, z, w] (picture in its x-y plane, front +z), size hat units across its full 16-pixel square
note: Crown larder only (user 2026-10-26: no food on the brim). The server reads the larder occupancy from hat_deck_layout.json, which interactions/marisa-hat-vessel/deck.py measures from these cells.
